column2: English   Blocks 00-09 = towns and villages (| = line break, ▼ = wait for button / new page, » … % = menu choice, {N} = number, {ATK}/{TGT} = attacker/target name)
Six months ago, this place was full of life. But ever since a creature called the Beast Demon King settled in the mountains up north... ▼ the town has fallen into decline.
Now the town will come back to life. Thank you so much.
A man named "Shindara" used to come and go from the town up north, wearing the "Demonbane Armor." ▼ [07]The "night-vision scope" he carried could light up even the darkest caves.
Oh, that's the "night-vision scope"! With that, even dark caves are nothing to be afraid of.
You can pass time at the inn. ▼ [07]And if you rest there for a night, your health and willpower will be restored.
The innkeeper was delighted, too.
Weapons and armor have to be "equipped", you know. If you don't equip them, they're useless. ▼ [07]Also, ranged weapons are handy. You can attack from a distance.
Has the weapon come in handy?
When you run out of "food," your health will start to drop. Be sure to buy some before you go.
Always keep some "food" with you.
The tavern is a treasure trove of information, but you'll need plenty of money. ▼ [07]If you're lucky, you might even find companions for your journey.
Good luck on the rest of your journey!
If you see an entrance to a building, it's a good idea to try going inside.
You defeated the Beast Demon King? Thank you so much!
They say there's an old man who knows about the Beast Demon King.
I hear the Beast Demon King was defeated, but I doubt anyone can beat Susano Oh...
If you set up camp and rest, your health and willpower will be restored. ▼ [07]But you may be attacked, so be careful.
Keep up the good work.
Traveling alone is dangerous. Gather companions and fight together. ▼ [07]What? Where can you find them? Go to the tavern and you'll find some.
Thank you so much.
Rumor has it the "night-vision scope" was hidden in some cave. ▼ [07]And it seems the cave's entrance is hidden, too.
They say that across the sea, on the Western Continent, many people are suffering.
Before the Beast Demon King came, people traveled to and from "Tugboat Town" in the north. ▼ [07]But... now that the "night-vision scope" is gone, we can't get there anymore.
I heard a man named Susa found the "night-vision scope"...? ▼ [07]What?! You're Susa?! Then please, you must go to "Tugboat Town"!
They say the Beast Demon King is truly fearsome... ▼ But Susano Oh is even more terrifying.
Sigh... I heard "an even worse demon beast is coming." I wonder if it's true...
This is "Lake Town." See the lake to the north? That's where the name comes from.
Don't you think "Lake Town" is a nice name?
The girl in the house seems so down. I wonder what's wrong.
The girl in the house is so much better now! ▼ [07]You're so cool, mister! Go beat up more demon beasts!
Mister, beat the demon beasts!
Thank you, mister!
What are you doing?!
Thank you so much for saving my dad!
To the south lies the Continent of Darkness. There is no daytime there. Only night.
You can go, but be careful not to get yourself killed!
The Continent of Darkness... they say that's where the strongest Susano Oh is.
The last man to use that key said he would be keeping "watch."
If you head for the Continent of Darkness, you may learn something about Susano Oh.
The last man to cross over to the Continent of Darkness was a very strong man. He may still be alive.
Heard about that weirdo? Kuwahara delivers food to him every month!
Huh? You're the one delivering it this month?
You know that Kuwahara guy? He's an odd one who lives in the house with the field. ▼ [07]But he... [14]0 they say he's got some secret.
That Kuwahara is getting weirder and weirder.
They say someone strange lives in that cave east of the village.
Did you meet that strange guy? ▼ They say he used to be a ship's captain!
To lower the bridge you need a key. The old man who lives east of "Lake Town" has it.
That key will lead you to something.
Someone is guarding the key, so the demon beasts can't cross over here.
You can use that key in one of the houses here in the village.
Mister! I'll tell you something useful. ▼ [07]Getting to the cave in the east means taking a really long way around.
Mister! You're going to the Continent of Darkness, aren't you? ▼ It's a really scary place.
This is "Drawbridge Village." We came over from a town across the sea, to the northwest.
This is "Drawbridge Village." Oh! You've brought the key.
What is it? Who're you? This town's in big trouble right now! ▼ [07]What? What kind of trouble? Go ask someone else!
This is "Tugboat Town." You can cross to the west from here.
You're the one who defeated the Beast Demon King?! Please! Save our town!
Thank you so much for defeating the Beast Demon King.
Terrible! Just terrible!
On the Western Continent, they say an evil cult is spreading. Apparently they worship demon beasts. What a frightful thing.
At night, a meeting is held in this house. What's discussed is a secret.
If you're heading west, take a ship. You can't cross on foot.
Mister! Please save my dad!
Mister! Beat Susano Oh!
We're in big trouble right now! What kind of trouble? Ask at the meeting!
If you want to ride the tugboat, go to the brick house.
There's a lookout hut on the cape out west to guard the tugboat, and it's in serious trouble!
Thank you so much.
Demon beasts have surrounded the hut, and the people inside can't get out.
Thank you so much.
We put together a rescue party, but they got beaten instead!
Thank you so much.
Hey! Please save the people in the hut!
Thank you so much.
There's a town in ruins to the northwest. Just one person lives there. His name is Hoshi, apparently.
That guy in the "Drawbridge Ruins"? I heard his tape recorder broke! Serves him right!
There's a village beyond the mountains up north. You can only get there from the northeast, across the desert.
There's a town in ruins to the northwest. They say someone fled there. ▼ [07]Apparently he escaped from the "Village of Hope."
Know about the evil cult? They say it's spreading the demon beasts' teachings! Ooh, gives me the shivers!
The guy in the "Drawbridge Ruins" is always listening to loud music!
This is "Gasoline Town." We have what little gasoline is left.
The other day the Airplane Man came by and said, "Sell me some gasoline." ▼ [07]Says he needs it to fly his airplane.
Across the desert to the northeast, there's a man who does sightseeing flights in an airplane.
I hear the Airplane Man went back to his island.
A man called "Ryuichi" is here right now.
Ryuichi headed for the ruins out in the sea to the east after that... I wonder if he's still alive.
They say the evil cult is spreading in the "Village of Hope," past the desert. They worship demon beasts.
The guy in the "Drawbridge Ruins" is called Hoshi. He's always listening to tapes, so he's really noisy.
They say the cultists are searching all over for something.
Head west and you'll find the "Drawbridge Ruins."
Someone from the evil cult came by the other day!
A guy from the cult asked me if I had any candles! ▼ [07]Hoshi has some, but it's a secret, so I didn't tell!
If you want to go east, take the tugboat. The pier is next to the weapon shop.
At night you can see a strange star. It's shaped just like a huge snake.
The Airplane Man's airplane is really scary. It's falling to pieces.
Don't tell me you're going to ride that airplane! ▼ [07]Do you have a death wish?!

Cross the desert to the northeast and go south along the coast, and you'll find the Airplane Man giving sightseeing flights. ▼ [07]He asked me to advertise for him, but... that beat-up old plane scares me.
You're not thinking of riding that wreck, are you?
I'm Ryuichi. I came from "Mountain Village" looking for the "PK Bomb."
It seems the "PK Bomb" is in the ruins out in the sea to the east. I'm planning to go there.
In the mountains south of the forest to the east, there are people who worship demon beasts.
Follow the road southwest and you'll reach a port town. ▼ They say there are ships there that can sail out into deep waters.
The cult's followers demand human sacrifices.
They say there's a feud going on in the port town to the southwest.
Please help us! They're making everyone in this village lose their minds!
Thank you so much.
The evil cult's founder is a demon beast. There's nothing we can do.
They say there's a town out at sea, too. ▼ [07]Apparently there's a man there who has gone through harsh spiritual training.
Many villagers have been taken away as sacrifices.
Thank you for saving my daughter.
It's the evil cult's curse! The curse of the cult in the mountains down south!
I once heard that Susano Oh's castle is out at sea.
My head hurts... ▼ Night and day, I keep hearing a voice.
They say in the port town there's a captain who knows everything about the sea.
The cult! The cult is coming! They're coming from the mountains down south, through the forest out east!
Thank you so much.
Please help us!
Thank you so much.
West of the village, the cultists built a checkpoint with mysterious powers, and they won't let anyone through.
Do you know a man named Uryuu? He has tremendous ESP. He said he was "heading southwest," so he must have gone to the port town.
If you want to board a ship, you should go to the town down south, but right now that's out of the question. We've fallen out with them.
We can go shopping in the town down south again!
We never got along with the town down south to begin with... but now it's worse than ever.
Really, I don't know how to thank you.
This is just between us, but our mayor's son ran away with the daughter of South Port's mayor!
I had no idea the two of them were in such danger.
There are lots of thieves in this town. It's a real headache.
The thieves are gone. But there are still demon beast spies around. There really are, I'm telling you!
They say Mr. Takamine knows all about the couple who ran away. He lives east of town.
Mr. Takamine was very grateful. He said he'd love for you to come by his house again.
Cross the bridge and you can get to the town down south... but the mayor won't let anyone through. ▼ [07]The mayor's house? It's in the middle of the pond.
After all this commotion, even our stubborn mayor must have learned his lesson, at least a little.
Good grief! That mayor's stubborn as they come! ▼ [07]The mayor? He lives in the house in the middle of the pond.
The two of them said they want to thank you in person.
I can't go play in the town down south. I'm so bored!
I can finally see Uribo! I'm so happy!
A man named Uryuu came by, looking for a woman called Yukishiro. ▼ [07]He said he'd head to sea from the town down south...
Oh, right, I just remembered! He said that if a man named Susa came along, I should tell him, "I'm heading for the Sea Castle."
You want to go to the town down south? I won't allow it! I absolutely won't allow it!!!
Well, I'm truly sorry. It feels as if my eyes have been opened. The bridge is open again... ▼ [07]I'm truly ashamed.
A
Thank you so much. We're going to live together in this town!
A
Thank you so much! We get to live together now! ▼ [07]I'm so happy!
This is "North Port." You've come at a bad time...
This is "North Port." It's connected to "South Port" by a bridge.
You want to go out to sea? Go to the house at the east end. ▼ That's where the sailors gather.
They say "Mountain Village," west of here, is in real trouble! ▼ [07]Poor things... Isn't there some way we can help them?
There are strong demon beasts at sea, so please be careful.
They say many demon beasts are after you. Please be careful.
They say some amazing weapon is hidden in the "East Lighthouse." ▼ [07]It seems a demon beast stole it from someone, but there's no way to get there.
You can get to the "East Lighthouse"! They say "Tech City" has an amazing ship called a hovercraft that can come ashore anywhere!
I heard about "Tech City." They say the old civilization still survives there. I really want to go.
I went to "Tech City," but you can't get in without an "ID card." Talk about unfair!
I can't say this too loudly... ▼ [07]but they say... there's a Susano Oh of the Sea.
I can't say this too loudly... ▼ [07]but they say... there's a Susano Oh of the Mountain.
They say strong demon beasts attack anyone who heads west. ▼ [07]Apparently they're waiting for the famous Susa...
You're Susa, aren't you! Thank you so much!
You should meet the captain. He's a man who knows everything there is to know about the sea.
Oh! So you're Susa! You have my gratitude!
Use the "West Lighthouse" as a landmark and head south, and you'll find a town on an island.
They say "Mountain Village," beyond the mountains to the west, is in trouble. Won't you please go and help them?
Plains Town is overrun with demon beasts! It's hopeless... ▼ [07]I barely managed to escape myself...
Plains Town is famous for its good weapons, you know.
I fled from "Plains Town." The demon beasts are terrifying.
They say the weapon shop in "Plains Town" has stocked some amazing new shield.
Hello, mister!
Heh heh heh!
Use the "West Lighthouse" as a landmark and head south, and you'll find an island. ▼ [07]They say there's someone on the island who knows something important.
The mountains are west of here. To reach "Mountain Village," you have to take the long way around their southern side.
The captain? ▼ He's taking a break at home. ▼ His house is in the northwest corner of town!
What do you want?! I was in such a good mood!
You want to board a ship? ▼ Ask the man over in the right corner.
Fine ship, wasn't she! ▼ But they say there's an even better ship in "Tech City."
The ships here can only sail in deep water, and can only dock at piers. ▼ [07]Always keep an eye on the tide, and get to deep water before it turns shallow.
Have you heard about a hovercraft that doesn't have to worry about how deep the water is?
Use the "West Lighthouse" as a landmark and head south, and there's a town on an island. They sell awesome weapons there!
Ahh... ▼ I'd love to ride that hovercraft.
